record.edic_text:
4088 pikria {pik-ree'-ah}

from 4089; TDNT - 6:122,839; n f

AV - bitterness 4; 4

1) bitter gall
   1a) extreme wickedness
   1b) a bitter root, and so producing a bitter fruit
   1c) metaph. bitterness, bitter hatred

使…變苦；＜被＞變苦；刻薄對待或虐待
苦；憎恨，惡毒的感受或怨恨
